title: pokemon paintings
description: just a simple pack that adds pokemon paintings
body:
#  **Pokémon Paintings – A Decorative Pokémon‑Themed Painting Overhaul**

Step into a world where Minecraft creativity meets Pokémon nostalgia. Pokémon Paintings is a vibrant, lovingly crafted resource‑pack‑style modpack that replaces every vanilla painting with Pokémon‑themed artwork — from classic sprites and iconic battles to cozy scenes, fan‑favorite characters, and beautifully reimagined illustrations. Your builds don’t just get decorated… they get elevated.

Whether you’re designing a Pokémon‑themed base, building a full adventure map, or simply want your survival home to feel more alive, this pack turns every wall into a chance to show off your love for the Pokémon universe. It’s simple, stylish, and instantly transforms the atmosphere of your world.

✨ What Makes This Pack Special
A full painting overhaul – Every single vanilla painting is replaced with Pokémon art that fits perfectly into Minecraft’s aesthetic.

A curated mix of styles – From retro pixel sprites to modern illustrations, each piece is chosen to feel nostalgic yet fresh.

Perfect for themed builds – Gyms, labs, cozy cabins, Pixelmon servers, adventure maps… everything looks better with Pokémon on the walls.

Drop‑in ready – No extra mods needed. Just install, enable, and enjoy.

Lightweight & compatible – Works smoothly alongside most modpacks, shaders, and resource packs.

🎨 A Gallery Worth Exploring
This isn’t just a simple texture swap — it’s a full decorative experience. Each painting has been carefully formatted to match Minecraft’s original sizes, ensuring they feel natural in any build. Hang a tiny sprite above your enchanting table, place a dramatic legendary battle in your hallway, or create a full gallery wall in your base. The possibilities are endless, and every painting adds personality.

🌟 Why You’ll Love It
Pokémon Paintings brings charm, color, and nostalgia into your world without changing gameplay or adding complexity. It’s perfect for builders who want their spaces to feel unique, fans who want to blend two beloved worlds, or anyone who thinks their walls deserve a little more magic.

This pack is all about expression — your base becomes a canvas, and your walls become a celebration of the Pokémon universe.

📥 Installation
Drop the pack into your resourcepacks folder

Enable it in‑game

Start decorating your world with Pokémon flair

That’s it — no configs, no dependencies, just pure aesthetic joy.
